# Agenda

- Laser League data tour (columns that matter this week)
- Build reproducible wrangling pipelines
- Standardize text + handle missing values
- Summaries + quick visuals to describe a cleaned dataset

---

# Laser League Players (Recap)

- Path we will use in labs:  
  `ENIA_ROOT <- "~/ENIA-5120"`  
  `players <- readr::read_csv(file.path(ENIA_ROOT, "data", "laser_league_players.csv"))`
- Core columns for wrangling
  - `player_id`, `squad_id`, `role`, `preferred_loadout`
  - Numeric performance fields: `season_score`, `tag_accuracy_pct`, `assists`
  - Text columns with inconsistent casing: `home_arena`, `favorite_drink`

---

# Tidyverse Wrangling Workflow

```r
library(dplyr)
library(janitor)

league_clean <- players %>%
  clean_names() %>%                # snake_case column names
  distinct(player_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%  # remove duplicates
  mutate(
    squad_id = toupper(trimws(squad_id)),
    home_arena = stringr::str_to_title(home_arena),
    preferred_loadout = tidyr::replace_na(preferred_loadout, "Unknown Loadout")
  )
```

- Keep verbs in a logical order so it reads like a story
- Store intermediate versions when testing (e.g., `league_raw`, `league_dedup`)

---

# Handling Missing Values

- Numeric fields → decide between dropping, imputing, or flagging
- For Lab 02 we will use **group-wise medians** for `season_score`

```r
score_imputed <- league_clean %>%
  group_by(squad_name) %>%
  mutate(
    season_score = if_else(
      is.na(season_score),
      median(season_score, na.rm = TRUE),
      season_score
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

- Always explain *why* a choice was made (Canvas submission comment or knit text)

---

# Summary Tables

```r
arena_summary <- score_imputed %>%
  group_by(home_arena) %>%
  summarise(
    players = n(),
    avg_accuracy = mean(tag_accuracy_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_accuracy))
```

- Use `summarise()` for aggregate metrics
- Remember `na.rm = TRUE`
- Keep resulting table for future joins/visualizations

---

# Quick Visuals from Summaries

```r
library(ggplot2)

arena_plot <- arena_summary %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(home_arena, avg_accuracy), y = avg_accuracy)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#ff5ef0") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Home Arena",
    y = "Avg Tag Accuracy (%)",
    title = "Laser League accuracy by arena"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

- Even simple bar charts help validate that summaries make sense
- Save ggplot objects so graders (and future you) can inspect them
